_review.ventricular_dilation: mild/moderate/severe ventriculomegaly are separated by a few mm of atrial width; the model could not separate them (severe: 0/9 recall). Colpocephaly is a disproportionate-dilation pattern of the same family. Confirm with a clinician before publishing.
_review.posterior_fossa: cerebellar hypoplasia, mega cisterna magna and Chiari malformation are all assessed in the trans-cerebellar / posterior-fossa plane.
_review.forebrain_malformation_or_destruction: holoprosencephaly, hydranencephaly and porencephaly all present as large fluid-filled / fused supratentorial spaces. Holoprosencephaly is embryologically different; split it out if it has enough independent cases.
_review.mass_cyst_or_herniation: arachnoid cyst, intracranial tumour, haemorrhage, vein of Galen malformation and encephalocele are focal lesions. This is the most heterogeneous group; each member has very few independent cases, so it is the least certain merge.
